events.label: Kick-off
events.purpose: Start the work and secure plant access
attendees: Plant Directors of the six plants
events.decision: Which two plants open their floors and cost data for the diagnosis in weeks 1 to 3?
agenda: Present the diagnostic approach and plan of work
Discuss the data and people the floor diagnosis needs
Decide which two plants open their floors and cost data

events.label: Workshop 1: baselines
events.purpose: Review plant baselines and loss areas
attendees: Plant Directors of the six plants
events.decision: Which loss areas should the sizing in the go/no-go pack cover in detail?
agenda: Review cost-per-part baselines for all six plants
Discuss the loss map for the first two plants
Decide which loss areas the sizing covers in detail

events.label: Initiative go/no-go
events.purpose: Decide on the sized improvements and pilot
attendees: Plant Directors of the six plants
events.decision: Go or no-go on the sized improvements, and which plant pilots them first?
agenda: Review the sized improvement list by plant
Present the go/no-go pack with the pilot plant options
Decide go or no-go and which plant pilots first

events.label: Workshop 2: pilot readiness
events.purpose: Check pilot plant readiness before go-live
attendees: Plant Directors of the six plants
events.decision: Go or no-go on taking the pilot plant changes live as planned?
agenda: Present the pilot plant change plan
Review the readiness pack before any change goes live
Decide whether the pilot plant changes go live

events.label: Check-in: pilot results
events.purpose: Review pilot results before wave 1 starts
attendees: Plant Directors of the six plants
events.decision: Start wave 1 as planned, or adjust the rollout approach first?
agenda: Review the pilot plant go-live record and savings
Present the cost-per-part tracker on each plant's baseline
Decide whether wave 1 starts as planned

events.label: Workshop 3: wave 2 start
attendees: Plant Directors of the six plants
events.decision: Go or no-go on starting wave 2 in the remaining plants?
agenda: Review the go-live and training record for wave 1 plants
Align on the results and rollout status the final readout will cover
Decide whether wave 2 starts in the remaining plants

events.label: Final readout
events.purpose: Approve final results and rollout status
attendees: Plant Directors of the six plants
events.decision: Approve the final results and the running improvements in all six plants?
agenda: Present the cost-per-part report by plant after wave 1
Review the final readout pack and the remaining plants' go-live record
Decide whether to approve the results and the running improvements
